name: Answer Ledger
summary: Turn authorized knowledge into cited response drafts, review each answer, and track human handoffs. English keyword retrieval; no AI or automatic sending.

actions.label: Add authorized knowledge
actions.help: Paste a source you have permission to use. Adding knowledge requires existing responses to be refreshed.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Source URL
fields.help: An http or https page you can check. The application does not fetch it.

fields.name: content
fields.label: Source text
fields.help: Paste the authorized policy or help article. Use short sentences or paragraphs (up to 1,200 characters per passage).

fields.name: authorized
fields.label: I am authorized to use this source for customer support

actions.label: Add customer question
actions.help: Create a ticket, then retrieve relevant excerpts.

fields.name: customerLabel
fields.label: Order or ticket reference
fields.help: Optional reference; avoid unnecessary personal details.

actions.label: Retrieve evidence and draft
actions.help: Matches words from the question against supplied source passages. Up to three verbatim excerpts are shown. A missing match sends the ticket to human review.

actions.label: Write or revise the response
actions.help: Use the displayed citations to write a clear answer. Editing clears approval. Retrieve again first if knowledge has changed.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Complete response text
fields.help: Refer to evidence with [1], [2], or [3] where useful. Citations remain attached to this ticket.

actions.label: Approve response
actions.help: Read the selected ticket and each citation before confirming. Only current evidence-backed drafts can be approved.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: I checked every claim against the cited sources

actions.label: Confirm ticket handled
actions.help: Record that you handled this approved response through your usual support channel. This does not send a message.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Handling note
fields.help: For example: Reply sent in help desk ticket #123.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: I confirm this ticket was handled outside this application

actions.label: Record human handoff
actions.help: For a ticket marked needs-human, record the owner and next step. Add supporting knowledge before trying another draft.

actions.label: Replace a knowledge source
actions.help: Paste the complete replacement. Earlier source versions are retained, and existing responses need refreshed evidence and approval.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Source URL
fields.help: An http or https page you can check. The application does not fetch it.

fields.name: content
fields.label: Source text
fields.help: Paste the authorized policy or help article. Use short sentences or paragraphs (up to 1,200 characters per passage).

fields.name: authorized
fields.label: I am authorized to use this source for customer support

actions.label: Retire a knowledge source
actions.help: Removes the source from retrieval and invalidates existing response approvals. Replace the source to reactivate it.
